# Activate the Vault OAuth resource server

OAuth resource server functionality is available in Vault Enterprise 2.0.0 and
later without requiring an activation flag. To begin using Vault as an OAuth 2.0
resource server, create an OAuth resource server profile that establishes trust
with your identity provider.

Refer to [Vault OAuth resource server](/vault/docs/ai/oauth-server) for an
overview of profiles, key validation modes, and supported algorithms.

Once you have at least one profile configured, Vault validates OAuth JWTs
presented in the `X-Vault-Token` header and resolves caller identity through the
matching entity alias. Refer to
[Secure agent permissions with Vault](/vault/docs/ai/iam/setup) for a full
end-to-end setup walkthrough.
